title: Spherical k-means as a feature dictionary
description: When features are sparse, most activation vectors are dominated by one feature, so their directions cluster on the unit sphere around the true feature directions. Clustering normalized activations with cosine k-means should place one centroid per feature, with less redundancy between atoms than a TopK SAE, and needs no sparsity hyperparameter.

source.title: Concept decompositions for large sparse text data using clustering
